
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- esp8266_blink_compiles.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp8266` to volt.toml: chip = "esp8266"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp8266
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- esp8266_blink_compiles.volt:5[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 2 must be HIGH at boot. Often connected to onboard LED.

 [dim]4 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]5 |[/dim]     pin led: Output = 2
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^[/yellow]
